annotations.title: List tracked links on this account

description: Lists the account's tracked links, newest first: the slug, the recipient label, the document title, whether it has been opened and when, and the share and document ids for each link. A link made in an earlier conversation is found here. The `opened` and `last_open` fields show which links nobody has opened. Returns at most 50 per call; the `before` cursor pages back through older links.

before.description: Cursor for the next page: the `next_before` value printed at the end of a previous list_shares result, of the form <created_at>|<share id>. Its exact value selects the next page; omission selects the most recent links.

name: list_shares
title: List tracked links on this account
